instructionalContract.applicationProblemText:
Christine has 12 math problems for homework. It takes her 5 minutes to complete each problem. How many
minutes does it take Christine to finish all 12 problems?


Note: This problem anticipates the Concept Development. It activates prior knowledge from Grade 2 about
math with minutes. Twelve is a new factor. If students are unsure about how to multiply 12 groups of 5,
encourage them to solve by skip-counting. They can also use the distributive property, 10 fives + 2 fives or
6 fives + 6 fives. Students use the solution to this problem as a springboard for modeling 12 intervals of
5 minutes on the number line in the Concept Development.
